Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “longest win streak” by imposing a strict wins-only definition (treating a tie as breaking the streak) and concluded the record is 22 by the 2017 Indians. The question did not specify this narrower definition, and authoritative historical records commonly recognize the 1916 New York Giants’ 26-game streak (with a tie not counted in standings and not breaking the streak). The Planner prematurely declared the task complete without reconciling this nuance or validating against authoritative sources that list 26 as the MLB record.
